veranderings.rede: 'Dieper in' is the natural Afrikaans phrase; 'dieper binne' sounds stilted.

veranderings.voor: want baie is daar vir beweging
veranderings.na: want baie van hulle help met beweging
veranderings.rede: 'Baie is daar vir beweging' is wooden; 'baie van hulle help met beweging' reads naturally and keeps the meaning and the quantifier.
